ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. is processing requests from four "Promoter Group" members (two individuals and two entities) to be reclassified as "Public" shareholders under SEBI regulations. The key takeaway is that these parties currently hold no equity shares in the company, signifying this is a formal regulatory update reflecting their non-involvement rather than a change in actual shareholding or immediate control. This reclassification, once approved, will formally reduce the size of the promoter group, potentially enhancing transparency, and presents no immediate financial red flags.
